segments.note: Construction began 1851 from Harmar (across the Muskingum River from Marietta); the 173-mile line to Loveland opened April 9, 1857, using trackage rights over the Little Miami Railroad for the final stretch into downtown Cincinnati. The company went bankrupt in 1858 and emerged from reorganization in 1860, the same year the B&O opened a car-ferry connection (the Union Railroad, Scott's Landing-Belpre) across the Ohio River at Marietta/Parkersburg, an important early B&O gateway to the Midwest. Frequency estimated, unsourced.

segments.note: The B&O took direct control in 1882, reorganizing the line as the Cincinnati, Washington and Baltimore Railway; folded into the Baltimore and Ohio Southwestern Railroad in 1889. Passenger service wound down through the mid-20th century, ending with Amtrak's creation May 1, 1971. Frequency estimated, unsourced.
